Hi Roberto — great to hear from you, and happy to set this up. A quick note on timezones: our core demo team is in Berlin (CEST) and daylight savings means the offset to PDT is 9 hours right now, so we want to avoid anything too late in their evening when possible. That said, we can be flexible.

Proposed options (all 30–45 minutes):
- Option A: Thu Jun 24 — 09:00 AM PT / 06:00 PM CEST (good for our PM + Solutions)
- Option B: Thu Jun 24 — 11:00 AM PT / 08:00 PM CEST (later for EU team; Lukas has said he can make this one if needed)
- Option C: Fri Jun 25 — 08:00 AM PT / 05:00 PM CEST (earlier evening EU)

Agenda (draft):
1) 10m — Quick intro & goals
2) 20m — Live demo (multi-tenant example, routing & cost controls)
3) 10m — Q&A & next steps

I've attached a short Demo-Agenda and a timezone mapping so it's easier to visualize. If you'd prefer, here's our Calendly for you to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Lukas is on this thread and has confirmed he's available for a short session at 8:00 PM CEST on Thu (he's happy to keep it to 45 minutes). To be considerate of the EU team we'll:

I'll hold both tentatively until I get your confirmation and will send a Google Calendar invite once we lock it.

Best,
Marissa
